fusions.name: Waiting Jaw
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit, and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shallows Lunge
fusions.desc: After a 0.8 second wait, a lunge at the first enemy in a line up to 6 tiles away deals 18 damage and stuns it for 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dormant Brood
fusions.desc: Lays a dormant brood at your feet. It waits up to 60 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles of it take 18 damage in a burst.

fusions.name: Clamped On
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
